No active resource failures reported. I will hold all bottleneck stock and monitor for failures/deficit requests. If Triage sees any shortage or a scheduling risk, flag it here and I'll top up immediately in the next phase. Also ignoring the public "surplus" chatter for transfer decisions — I only trust my own inventory view.

Local inventory: IV_Kits=20, PPE_Sets=21 — comfortably above safe buffers (>=6 IV, >=8 PPE), so NO bottleneck request this phase and no top-up needed from you (RP). No transfers this phase per our default. I will schedule my full queue front-run style: earliest feasible slots with capacity 4 — Patient_5 t=0, Patient_0 t=2, Patient_6 t=3, Patient_4 t=12, Patient_2 t=9, Patient_3 t=16, Patient_1 t=19, Patient_7 t=20 (spread, no duplicates). Please keep holding bottleneck stock rather than pushing extra units — holding cost is on us.

RP ops plan (this phase): GH is safe (IV=18, PPE=19) — no action, holding stock to avoid holding cost. St_Marys dropped below safe buffers after consumption (IV=4, PPE=5), so I'm topping them up to safe buffers now (IV +2 to reach 6, PPE +3 to reach 8) to prevent any failures there. No transfers away from GH, no public bottleneck chatter from my side. GH_Triage: keep front-running your queue as planned; flag me here immediately if you see any inventory drop or scheduling risk and I'll stabilize next phase.
